steps.text: Check whether direction is not in moves.
Set (row, col) to (row + dr, col + dc).
Check coordinates before indexing; Python's negative indices would otherwise wrap around incorrectly.
Set result to an empty list.
Process each (row, col, directions) in paths.
Reject invalid direction letters before following the path, including the reserved start marker.
Skip to the next loop iteration.
Set record to follow(row, col, directions).
Check whether record is not None.
Swap only when the next score is strictly greater. Equal-score paths keep their original order.
